Built scene using Revideo Path components with procedural SVG path generation including arc corners and edge deformation

Used parametric timing constants (23 non-nice floats) measured from reference video for animation phase transitions
Modeled shape morphing as corner radius changes and edge dents rather than proper polygon vertex interpolation
